title: CorrFlow: Exact and Permutation-Equivariant Flow Matching on the Correlation Elliptope
abstract: arXiv:2610.13606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Correlation matrices combine nonlinear positive-definiteness constraints with a simultaneous row-column permutation symmetry. Their generation therefore involves two distinct problems. First, every output must remain on the correlation elliptope, irrespective of how its variables are ordered. Second, the generator must learn the domain-specific distribution occupied by empirical data inside that valid space. Existing financial image generators mix these problems: they learn ordered matrix entries and repair invalid draws afterward. We introduce CorrFlow, which separates them. A generalized Fisher transform maps full-rank correlation matrices bijectively to unconstrained coordinates, guaranteeing valid outputs without projection. A graph flow-matching network learns the empirical distribution in those coordinates and is permutation equivariant: reordering the variables only reorders the output. We compare a conditional CorrGAN reimpleme

translated_title: CorrFlow：相关椭圆面上的精确且置换等变的流匹配
translated_abstract: 相关矩阵同时结合了非线性正定性约束与行列同时置换的对称性，因此其生成涉及两个截然不同的问题：第一，无论变量如何排序，每个输出都必须位于相关椭圆面上；第二，生成器必须学习经验数据在该有效空间内所占据的特定领域分布。现有的金融图像生成器将这两个问题混在一起：它们学习有序的矩阵元素，然后再事后修复无效的采样结果。我们提出了CorrFlow，将这两个问题分离开来。一个广义Fisher变换将满秩相关矩阵双射地映射到无约束坐标，从而无需投影即可保证输出的有效性。一个图流匹配网络在这些坐标中学习经验分布，并且具有置换等变性：对变量重新排序只会使输出相应地重新排序。我们比较了重新实现的条件CorrGAN……
tldr: CorrFlow通过广义Fisher变换将满秩相关矩阵双射映射到无约束坐标，再用置换等变的图流匹配网络学习其经验分布，从而无需投影即可精确保证输出位于相关椭圆面上，并对变量排序保持等变性。
en_tdlr: CorrFlow bijectively maps full-rank correlation matrices to unconstrained coordinates via a generalized Fisher transform and learns their distribution with a permutation-equivariant graph flow-matching network, guaranteeing exact validity on the correlation elliptope without projection while remaining equivariant to variable ordering.
